categories.name: Terrain & Ground Surfaces
categories.description: Base soils, loess dirt, river silt, farmland, flagstones, and seasonal ground layers of ancient China.

categories.name: Roads, Paths & Bridges
categories.vietnamese_name: Đường Đi, Cầu Cống & Kênh Đào
categories.description: Courier highways, stone arched bridges, canal towpaths, village alleys, and wooden river crossings.

categories.name: Village & Town Living
categories.vietnamese_name: Thôn Trang, Thị Trấn & Dân Cư
categories.description: Courtyard homes, thatched peasant cottages, village teahouses, wine taverns, pharmacies, and clan halls.

categories.name: Imperial Administration & Law
categories.vietnamese_name: Nha Môn, Công Đường & Quân Pháp
categories.description: County magistrate courts, Drum of Grievance, imperial jails, pillories, courier post-stations, and wanted boards.

categories.name: Fortresses, Gates & Borders
categories.vietnamese_name: Thành Quách, Tiêu Điểm & Biên Giới
categories.description: Rammed-earth ramparts, crenellated brick bastions, gatehouses with portcullises, beacon towers, and barracks.

categories.name: Warfare, Siege & Battle Ruins
categories.vietnamese_name: Chiến Trường, Công Thành & Tàn Tích
categories.description: Spiked barricades, catapult batteries, broken supply wagons, battle arrows stuck in soil, and war drums.

categories.name: Canal, Fishery & River Docks
categories.vietnamese_name: Bến Thuyền, Kênh Đào & Thủy Đạo
categories.description: Wooden piers, houseboats, fishing sampans, cargo grain barges, ferry crossings, and fish-drying racks.

categories.name: Industry, Crafts & Sericulture
categories.vietnamese_name: Nghề Thủ Công, Lò Gốm & Khai Khoáng
categories.description: Salt evaporation flats, ceramic brick kilns, charcoal burning mounds, iron forges, and silk dye vats.

categories.name: Bandits, Wilderness Inns & Shadow World
categories.vietnamese_name: Sơn Tặc, Hắc Điếm & Tiêu Cục
categories.description: Mountain bandit stockades, skull boundary poles, remote wilderness inns (Dragon Gate style), and escort wagons.

categories.name: Folk Shrines, Graves & Feng Shui
categories.vietnamese_name: Miếu Thần, Lăng Mộ & Phong Thủy
categories.description: Earth God shrines (Thổ Địa Miếu), City God altars, roadside warding stones, ancestral burial mounds, and incense urns.

categories.name: Low-Tier Sects & Qi Condensation
categories.vietnamese_name: Sơ Nhập Tu Tiên & Môn Phái Dân Gian
categories.description: Martial training grounds, wooden training dummies, iron sand pans, bronze medicinal stoves, and Qi-testing steles.

categories.name: Destructibles & Treasure Containers
categories.description: Glazed wine jars, wooden supply crates, grain urns, merchant lockboxes, bandit iron chests, and loose pavers.

categories.name: Commoners, Troops & Draft Beasts
categories.vietnamese_name: Nhân Vật, Binh Sĩ & Súc Vật
categories.description: Peasants, dockers, magistrates, soldiers, wandering wuxia fighters, water buffaloes, mules, and watchdogs.

categories.name: Plants, Trees & Atmospheric Dressing
categories.vietnamese_name: Thực Vật, Cảnh Quan & Khí Quyển
categories.description: Weeping willows, ginkgo trees, peach orchards, bamboo groves, red festival lanterns, wine flag banners, and scarecrows.

categories.name: Modular Timber Architecture Kits
categories.vietnamese_name: Bộ Lắp Ghép Kiến Trúc Gỗ & Ngõ Hẻm
categories.description: Modular foundations, plinths, dougong brackets, vermilion pillars, lattice windows, moon gates, grey tile flying eaves, and covered verandas for custom courtyards and compounds.

categories.name: Mountain Geology, Cliffs & Waters
categories.vietnamese_name: Sơn Địa, Vách Đá, Thác Nước & Hang Động
categories.description: Stratified loess bluff walls, karst limestone peaks, jagged scree slopes, boulders, hidden grottos, waterfall drops, and mountain streams.

categories.name: Forest Ecology, Ancient Trees & Undergrowth
categories.vietnamese_name: Thảm Thực Vật Rừng, Tùng Bách & Thảo Dược
categories.description: Ancient craggy Huangshan pines, bamboo grove thickets, climbing ivy, ferns, wetland cattails, lotus beds, and wild mountain medicinal herbs.

categories.name: Urban Street Life, Markets & Infrastructure
categories.vietnamese_name: Phố Xá, Chợ Búa, Biển Hiệu & Tiện Ích
categories.description: Hawker stalls, butcher tables, merchant awnings, hanging trade signs, tavern wine banners, stone wellheads, street braziers, and mud wheel ruts.

categories.name: Rural Farming, Irrigation & Homestead
categories.vietnamese_name: Nông Thôn, Thủy Lợi, Chuồng Trại & Điền Viên
categories.description: Wooden noria waterwheels, bamboo irrigation flumes, animal coops and pig pens, vegetable trellises, hanging garlic/chili braids, and grain haystacks.
